---
title: Add Dashboard Tile - Advanced Configuration
description: Configure dashboard tiles with DataController for complex data processing when QBE filtering is not sufficient
keywords: 'ibm,maximo,dashboard,tile,mobile,datacontroller,json-datasource,allowedAllRecordsLoadDS'
date: 01 April 2026
hiddenFromSearch: false
difficulty: complex
---

## Overview

This guide shows how to add dashboard tiles that require loading all records and performing complex data processing using DataController. This approach is needed when simple QBE filtering is not sufficient and you need to compute values across the entire dataset.

> **📋 Version Requirement**: The `mobile-shared-data-from` mechanism was introduced in **Maximo Application Suite (MAS) version 9.2.0**. Ensure your environment is running MAS 9.2.0 or later to use this feature.

> **📚 For comprehensive details on cross-app data sharing**, see the [Cross-App Datasource Sharing Guide](/advanced/cross-app-datasource-sharing) which covers multiple fallback sources, schema requirements, and advanced patterns.

### What is a Dashboard Tile?

Dashboard tiles display key metrics and counts. This advanced approach allows you to compute complex values across all records.

![Dashboard Tiles Example](../assets/dashboard-tiles-overview.png)

*Example dashboard tiles showing computed counts from multiple datasources*

**Use Cases:**
- Computing aggregated values across all records
- Complex filtering logic that can't be expressed in QBE
- Calculations requiring multiple datasource fields
- Custom business logic for tile values
- Scenarios where page-wise loading with QBE is not possible

**Prerequisites:**
- Understanding of [datasources](/datasources-guide)
- Knowledge of [DataController patterns](/concepts#event-lifecycle)
- Familiarity with [mobile-shared-data-from](/simple/add-dashboard-tile)
- Understanding of [cross-app datasource sharing](/advanced/cross-app-datasource-sharing)
- JavaScript/ES6 knowledge

## When to Use Advanced Configuration

Use this advanced approach when:
- ❌ QBE filtering cannot express your filtering logic
- ❌ You need to load ALL records from a datasource
- ❌ You need complex calculations across multiple fields
- ❌ You need custom aggregations or computations
- ✅ You're willing to manage memory carefully
- ✅ You understand the performance implications

**Important:** This approach loads more data into memory. Always test on actual mobile devices to ensure acceptable performance.

## Implementation

### Step 1: Add datasource to allowedAllRecordsLoadDS array

In your DataController, maintain an array of datasource IDs that are allowed to load all records. This is a safety mechanism to prevent accidentally loading too much data.

**DataController.js:**
```js
class DataController {
  
  /**
   * Datasources allowed to load all records
   * Add datasource IDs here that need full dataset for computation
   */
  allowedAllRecordsLoadDS = [
    'todaywoassignedDS',
    'reservationsListDS',
    'reservationsList4TransDS',
    'countBookListDS'
  ];
  
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
    this.datasource = datasource;
    this.app = app;
  }
  
  // Additional methods will be added in next steps
}

export default DataController;
```

**Key Points:**
- `allowedAllRecordsLoadDS`: Array of datasource IDs that can load all records
- Only datasources in this array will bypass page-size limitations
- This prevents accidental memory issues from loading too much data

### Step 2: Create maximo-datasource with mobile-shared-data-from

Create the maximo-datasource that shares data from another app. This datasource will load all records for processing.

**app.xml:**
```xml
<maximo-datasource 
  id="todaywoassignedDS" 
  object-structure="mxapiwodetail" 
  saved-query="ASSIGNEDWOLIST" 
  mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status_maxvalue': '!=COMP,CAN,CLOSE,WAPPR', 'hidewo': '!=HIDE'}}" 
  order-by="wopriority" 
  selection-mode="none" 
  offline-immediate-download="true" 
  pre-load="true" 
  page-size="50" 
  controller="DataController" 
  include-counts="true">
  
  <schema id="gjw7p">
    <attribute name="wonum" searchable="true" id="g4dk9"/>
    <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="ej423"/>
    <attribute name="status_maxvalue" index="true" id="v68e9"/>
    <attribute name="wopriority" searchable="true" id="x3nyj"/>
    <attribute name="schedfinish" filterable="true" id="d23z7"/>
    <attribute name="workorderid" unique-id="true" id="gzwj2"/>
    <attribute name="siteid" searchable="true" id="n9ryw"/>
  </schema>
  
  <!-- Share data from Technician app -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="todaywoassignedDS" id="link1"/>
</maximo-datasource>
```

### Step 3: Create JSON datasource for computed values

Create a JSON datasource to hold the computed values that will be displayed in the tile.

**app.xml:**
```xml
<json-datasource 
  id="todaywoassignedDS_json" 
  src="{[]}" 
  controller="DataController" 
  selection-mode="none" 
  page-size="50">
  
  <schema id="gjw7p_JSON">
    <attribute name="wonum" searchable="true" id="g4dk9_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="ej423_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="status_maxvalue" index="true" id="v68e9_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="wopriority" searchable="true" id="x3nyj_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="schedfinish" filterable="true" id="d23z7_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="workorderid" unique-id="true" id="gzwj2_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="computedIsOverDue" title="computedIsOverDue" 
               remarks="computedIsOverDue" id="bzz5w_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="computedTotalRecords" title="Total Records" 
               remarks="Total record count" id="ctr01_JSON"/>
  </schema>
</json-datasource>
```

**Key Points:**
- `src="{[]}"`: Starts with empty array, will be populated by DataController
- Includes computed attributes like `computedIsOverDue` and `computedTotalRecords`
- Schema matches maximo-datasource but adds computed fields

### Step 4: Implement DataController logic

Implement the DataController to load all records, perform computations, and populate the JSON datasource.

**DataController.js:**
```js
class DataController {
  
  /**
   * Datasources allowed to load all records
   */
  allowedAllRecordsLoadDS = [
    'todaywoassignedDS',
    'reservationsListDS',
    'reservationsList4TransDS',
    'countBookListDS'
  ];
  
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
    this.datasource = datasource;
    this.app = app;
  }
  
  /**
   * Called after datasource loads data
   * This is where we process all records and compute values
   */
  async onAfterLoadData(datasource, items) {
    // Only process if this datasource is in allowed list
    if (!this.allowedAllRecordsLoadDS.includes(datasource.name)) {
      return items;
    }
    
    // Load ALL records if datasource is allowed
    await this.loadAllRecords(datasource);
    
    // Get all items after loading
    const allItems = datasource.items || [];
    
    // Perform computations
    const computedData = this.computeValues(allItems, datasource.name);
    
    // Update corresponding JSON datasource
    await this.updateJsonDatasource(datasource.name, computedData);
    
    return items;
  }
  
  /**
   * Load all records from datasource
   * Bypasses page-size limitation for datasources in allowedAllRecordsLoadDS
   */
  async loadAllRecords(datasource) {
    try {
      // Check if more records available
      while (datasource.state.hasMore) {
        const currentCount = datasource.items.length;
        const pageSize = datasource.state.pageSize || 50;
        
        // Load next page
        await datasource.loadRange(
          currentCount,
          pageSize,
          datasource.options?.query
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Error loading all records for ${datasource.name}:`, error);
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Compute values based on all loaded records
   */
  computeValues(items, datasourceName) {
    const result = {
      computedTotalRecords: items.length,
      computedIsOverDue: 0
    };
    
    // Example: Count overdue work orders
    if (datasourceName === 'todaywoassignedDS') {
      const now = new Date();
      result.computedIsOverDue = items.filter(item => {
        if (item.schedfinish) {
          const schedFinish = new Date(item.schedfinish);
          return schedFinish < now && 
                 item.status_maxvalue !== 'COMP' && 
                 item.status_maxvalue !== 'CLOSE';
        }
        return false;
      }).length;
    }
    
    // Example: Count due and overdue reservations
    if (datasourceName === 'reservationsListDS' || 
        datasourceName === 'reservationsList4TransDS') {
      const now = new Date();
      let dueCount = 0;
      let overdueCount = 0;
      
      items.forEach(item => {
        if (item.requireddate) {
          const requiredDate = new Date(item.requireddate);
          if (requiredDate < now) {
            overdueCount++;
          } else {
            dueCount++;
          }
        }
      });
      
      result.computedDue = dueCount;
      result.computedOverDue = overdueCount;
    }
    
    // Example: Count books due for cycle count
    if (datasourceName === 'countBookListDS') {
      result.computedCountedDue = items.filter(item => {
        return item.status_maxvalue !== 'COMP';
      }).length;
    }
    
    return result;
  }
  
  /**
   * Update JSON datasource with computed values
   */
  async updateJsonDatasource(datasourceName, computedData) {
    const jsonDsName = `${datasourceName}_json`;
    const jsonDs = this.app.findDatasource(jsonDsName);
    
    if (jsonDs) {
      // Clear existing data
      await jsonDs.clearState();
      
      // Add computed data as single item
      await jsonDs.load({ src: [computedData] });
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Computed function for total records
   * Can be called from schema computed-function attribute
   */
  computedTotalRecords(item, datasource) {
    return datasource?.items?.length || 0;
  }
}

export default DataController;
```

### Step 5: Add dashboard tile

Add the dashboard tile that uses the JSON datasource with computed values.

![Reservations Tiles Example](../assets/dashboard-tile-reservations.png)

*Example tiles showing "Due issue reservations" (5 Items) and "Due transfer reservations" (2 Items)*

**app.xml:**
```xml
<page id="dashboardpage" title="Dashboard" controller="DashboardController">
  <dashboard id="dsdash1" use-with-mobile="true">
    
    <!-- Total work orders tile -->
    <dashboard-value-tile 
      id="dsdash1_t1" 
      datasource="todaywoassignedDS_json" 
      size="smallwide" 
      value-field="computedTotalRecords" 
      title="Assigned work orders" 
      unit="Tasks" 
      allow-extra-action="true" 
      on-extra-action-click="handleExtraAction" 
      on-extra-action-click-arg="{{name: 'techmobile'}}" 
      extra-actions="{{icon: 'carbon:chevron--right', title: 'Go to my schedule'}}" 
      hidden="{page.state.hideTechMobileTiles}"/>
    
    <!-- Overdue work orders tile -->
    <dashboard-value-tile 
      id="dsdash1_t2" 
      datasource="todaywoassignedDS_json" 
      size="smallwide" 
      value-field="computedIsOverDue" 
      title="Overdue work orders" 
      unit="Tasks" 
      allow-extra-action="true" 
      on-extra-action-click="handleExtraAction" 
      on-extra-action-click-arg="{{name: 'techmobile'}}" 
      extra-actions="{{icon: 'carbon:chevron--right', title: 'Go to my schedule'}}" 
      hidden="{page.state.hideTechMobileTiles}"/>
      
  </dashboard>
</page>
```

## Complete Example

Here's a complete example showing work order tiles with overdue calculation:

**app.xml:**
```xml

<maximo-application id="dashboardmobile" title="Dashboard" version="9.2.4.0">
  
  <!-- Maximo datasource with mobile-shared-data-from -->
  <maximo-datasource

    object-structure="mxapiwodetail" 
    saved-query="ASSIGNEDWOLIST" 
    mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status_maxvalue': '!=COMP,CAN,CLOSE,WAPPR', 'hidewo': '!=HIDE'}}" 
    order-by="wopriority" 
    selection-mode="none" 
    offline-immediate-download="true" 
    pre-load="true" 
    page-size="50" 
    controller="DataController" 
    include-counts="true">
    
    <schema id="gjw7p">
      <attribute name="wonum" searchable="true" id="g4dk9"/>
      <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="ej423"/>
      <attribute name="status_maxvalue" index="true" id="v68e9"/>
      <attribute name="wopriority" searchable="true" id="x3nyj"/>
      <attribute name="schedfinish" filterable="true" id="d23z7"/>
      <attribute name="workorderid" unique-id="true" id="gzwj2"/>
      <attribute name="siteid" searchable="true" id="n9ryw"/>
    </schema>
    
    <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="todaywoassignedDS" id="link1"/>
  </maximo-datasource>
  
  <!-- JSON datasource for computed values -->
  <json-datasource 
    id="todaywoassignedDS_json" 
    src="{[]}" 
    controller="DataController" 
    selection-mode="none" 
    page-size="50">
    
    <schema id="gjw7p_JSON">
      <attribute name="wonum" searchable="true" id="g4dk9_JSON"/>
      <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="ej423_JSON"/>
      <attribute name="status_maxvalue" index="true" id="v68e9_JSON"/>
      <attribute name="wopriority" searchable="true" id="x3nyj_JSON"/>
      <attribute name="schedfinish" filterable="true" id="d23z7_JSON"/>
      <attribute name="workorderid" unique-id="true" id="gzwj2_JSON"/>
      <attribute name="computedIsOverDue" title="computedIsOverDue" 
                 remarks="computedIsOverDue" id="bzz5w_JSON"/>
      <attribute name="computedTotalRecords" title="Total Records" 
                 remarks="Total record count" id="ctr01_JSON"/>
    </schema>
  </json-datasource>
  
  <!-- Dashboard page -->
  <pages id="pages">
    <page id="dashboardpage" title="Dashboard" controller="DashboardController">
      <dashboard id="dsdash1" use-with-mobile="true">
        
        <dashboard-value-tile 
          id="dsdash1_t1" 
          datasource="todaywoassignedDS_json" 
          size="smallwide" 
          value-field="computedTotalRecords" 
          title="Assigned work orders" 
          unit="Tasks" 
          allow-extra-action="true" 
          on-extra-action-click="handleExtraAction" 
          on-extra-action-click-arg="{{name: 'techmobile'}}" 
          extra-actions="{{icon: 'carbon:chevron--right', title: 'Go to my schedule'}}" 
          hidden="{page.state.hideTechMobileTiles}"/>
        
        <dashboard-value-tile 
          id="dsdash1_t2" 
          datasource="todaywoassignedDS_json" 
          size="smallwide" 
          value-field="computedIsOverDue" 
          title="Overdue work orders" 
          unit="Tasks" 
          allow-extra-action="true" 
          on-extra-action-click="handleExtraAction" 
          on-extra-action-click-arg="{{name: 'techmobile'}}" 
          extra-actions="{{icon: 'carbon:chevron--right', title: 'Go to my schedule'}}" 
          hidden="{page.state.hideTechMobileTiles}"/>
          
      </dashboard>

  </pages>

```

## Validation & Testing

**How to verify:**

1. **Check all records are loaded:**
   - Open browser DevTools console
   - Add logging in `loadAllRecords` method
   - Verify all pages are loaded
   - Check `datasource.items.length` matches total count

2. **Test computed values:**
   - Verify tile displays correct computed values
   - Compare with manual count in source app
   - Test edge cases (empty data, all overdue, etc.)

3. **Monitor memory usage:**
   - Open DevTools Memory tab
   - Load dashboard and check memory consumption
   - Verify acceptable on target mobile devices
   - Test with maximum expected data volume

4. **Test offline mode:**
   - Load source app while online
   - Enable airplane mode
   - Open dashboard app
   - Verify tiles display computed values

**Common Issues:**

- **Issue:** Tiles show 0 or incorrect values
  - **Cause:** DataController not processing data correctly
  - **Solution:** Add logging to `computeValues` method, verify logic

- **Issue:** Not all records loaded
  - **Cause:** Datasource not in `allowedAllRecordsLoadDS` array
  - **Solution:** Add datasource ID to the array

- **Issue:** Memory issues on mobile
  - **Cause:** Loading too many records
  - **Solution:** Reduce data volume with better mobile-qbe-filter, or use simple configuration

- **Issue:** JSON datasource not updating
  - **Cause:** Datasource name mismatch or update logic error
  - **Solution:** Verify JSON datasource name follows pattern `{datasourceName}_json`

## Best Practices

**✅ Do:**
- Add datasource to `allowedAllRecordsLoadDS` array explicitly
- Use mobile-qbe-filter to reduce initial data volume
- Test memory usage on actual mobile devices
- Add error handling in DataController methods
- Log computation steps for debugging
- Document why advanced configuration is needed
- Consider performance implications

**❌ Don't:**
- Load all records without adding to `allowedAllRecordsLoadDS`
- Skip mobile-qbe-filter (loads unnecessary data)
- Forget to test on low-end mobile devices
- Perform expensive computations in tight loops
- Ignore memory constraints
- Use this approach when simple QBE filtering would work

**Memory Optimization Tips:**
- Use mobile-qbe-filter to pre-filter data before loading all
- Only load fields needed for computation
- Clear intermediate data structures after computation
- Monitor memory usage during development
- Test with maximum expected data volume
- Consider pagination if dataset is very large

## Performance Considerations

**Loading All Records:**
- Each `loadRange` call fetches one page from local database
- Multiple pages = multiple database queries
- Can impact performance with very large datasets
- Always test with realistic data volumes

**Computation Performance:**
- Keep computation logic efficient
- Avoid nested loops where possible
- Use array methods like `filter`, `reduce` efficiently
- Consider caching computed values if recalculated frequently

**Memory Impact:**
- Loading all records increases memory usage
- JSON datasource adds additional memory overhead
- Test on devices with limited memory (older phones)
- Monitor memory in DevTools during development

## Related Resources

**Prerequisites:**
- [Datasources Guide](/datasources-guide) - Understanding datasources
- [Add Dashboard Tile - Simple](/simple/add-dashboard-tile) - Simple configuration with QBE
- [Cross-App Datasource Sharing](/advanced/cross-app-datasource-sharing) - Comprehensive guide on mobile-shared-data-from
- [Client-side Datasource Filtering](/simple/client-side-datasource-filtering) - In-memory filtering

**Related Practices:**
- [Dynamic Mobile QBE Filter](/advanced/dynamic-mobile-filter) - Dynamic filtering
- [Additional Logic to Controllers](/advanced/additional-logic) - Extending controllers

**Next Steps:**
- Consider if [Simple Configuration](/simple/add-dashboard-tile) would work for your use case
- Review [Performance Mobile Doclinks](/advanced/performance-mobile-doclinks) for optimization techniques
- Learn more about [Cross-App Datasource Sharing](/advanced/cross-app-datasource-sharing) patterns

## Summary

Use this advanced configuration when:
- ✅ QBE filtering cannot express your logic
- ✅ You need complex calculations across all records
- ✅ You need custom aggregations
- ✅ You've tested memory usage on target devices
- ✅ Simple configuration is insufficient

**Key Components:**
1. **allowedAllRecordsLoadDS**: Safety array for datasources that can load all records
2. **maximo-datasource**: Shares data from source app with mobile-qbe-filter
3. **json-datasource**: Holds computed values for tile display
4. **DataController**: Loads all records, computes values, updates JSON datasource

**Remember:** Always prefer the [Simple Configuration](/simple/add-dashboard-tile) when possible. Only use this advanced approach when absolutely necessary, and always test memory usage on actual mobile devices.

    if (!this.allowedAllRecordsLoadDS.includes(datasource.name)) {
      return items;
    }
    
    // Load ALL records if datasource is allowed
    await this.loadAllRecords(datasource);
    
    // Get all items after loading
    const allItems = datasource.items || [];
    
    // Perform computations
    const computedData = this.computeValues(allItems, datasource.name);
    
    // Update corresponding JSON datasource
    await this.updateJsonDatasource(datasource.name, computedData);
    
    return items;
  }
  
  /**
   * Load all records from datasource
   * Bypasses page-size limitation for datasources in allowedAllRecordsLoadDS
   */
  async loadAllRecords(datasource) {
    try {
      // Check if more records available
      while (datasource.state.hasMore) {
        const currentCount = datasource.items.length;
        const pageSize = datasource.state.pageSize || 50;
        
        // Load next page
        await datasource.loadRange(
          currentCount,
          pageSize,
          datasource.options?.query
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Error loading all records for ${datasource.name}:`, error);
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Compute values based on all loaded records
   */
  computeValues(items, datasourceName) {
    const result = {
      computedTotalRecords: items.length,
      computedIsOverDue: 0
    };
    
    // Example: Count overdue work orders
    if (datasourceName === 'todaywoassignedDS') {
      const now = new Date();
      result.computedIsOverDue = items.filter(item => {
        if (item.schedfinish) {
          const schedFinish = new Date(item.schedfinish);
          return schedFinish < now && 
                 item.status_maxvalue !== 'COMP' && 
                 item.status_maxvalue !== 'CLOSE';
        }
        return false;
      }).length;
    }
    
    // Example: Count due and overdue reservations
    if (datasourceName === 'reservationsListDS' || 
        datasourceName === 'reservationsList4TransDS') {
      const now = new Date();
      let dueCount = 0;
      let overdueCount = 0;
      
      items.forEach(item => {
        if (item.requireddate) {
          const requiredDate = new Date(item.requireddate);
          if (requiredDate < now) {
            overdueCount++;
          } else {
            dueCount++;
          }
        }
      });
      
      result.computedDue = dueCount;
      result.computedOverDue = overdueCount;
    }
    
    // Example: Count books due for cycle count
    if (datasourceName === 'countBookListDS') {
      result.computedCountedDue = items.filter(item => {
        return item.status_maxvalue !== 'COMP';
      }).length;
    }
    
    return result;
  }
  
  /**
   * Update JSON datasource with computed values
   */
  async updateJsonDatasource(datasourceName, computedData) {
    const jsonDsName = `${datasourceName}_json`;
    const jsonDs = this.app.findDatasource(jsonDsName);
    
    if (jsonDs) {
      // Clear existing data
      await jsonDs.clearState();
      
      // Add computed data as single item
      await jsonDs.load({ src: [computedData] });
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Computed function for total records
   * Can be called from schema computed-function attribute
   */
  computedTotalRecords(item, datasource) {
    return datasource?.items?.length || 0;
  }
}

export default DataController;
```

## Validation & Testing

**How to verify:**

1. **Check all records are loaded:**
   - Open browser DevTools console
   - Add logging in `loadAllRecords` method
   - Verify all pages are loaded
   - Check `datasource.items.length` matches total count

2. **Test computed values:**
   - Verify tile displays correct computed values
   - Compare with manual count in source app
   - Test edge cases (empty data, all overdue, etc.)

3. **Monitor memory usage:**
   - Open DevTools Memory tab
   - Load dashboard and check memory consumption
   - Verify acceptable on target mobile devices
   - Test with maximum expected data volume

4. **Test offline mode:**
   - Load source app while online
   - Enable airplane mode
   - Open dashboard app
   - Verify tiles display computed values

**Common Issues:**

- **Issue:** Tiles show 0 or incorrect values
  - **Cause:** DataController not processing data correctly
  - **Solution:** Add logging to `computeValues` method, verify logic

- **Issue:** Not all records loaded
  - **Cause:** Datasource not in `allowedAllRecordsLoadDS` array
  - **Solution:** Add datasource ID to the array

- **Issue:** Memory issues on mobile
  - **Cause:** Loading too many records
  - **Solution:** Reduce data volume with better mobile-qbe-filter, or use simple configuration

- **Issue:** JSON datasource not updating
  - **Cause:** Datasource name mismatch or update logic error
  - **Solution:** Verify JSON datasource name follows pattern `{datasourceName}_json`

## Best Practices

**✅ Do:**
- Add datasource to `allowedAllRecordsLoadDS` array explicitly
- Use mobile-qbe-filter to reduce initial data volume
- Test memory usage on actual mobile devices
- Add error handling in DataController methods
- Log computation steps for debugging
- Document why advanced configuration is needed
- Consider performance implications

**❌ Don't:**
- Load all records without adding to `allowedAllRecordsLoadDS`
- Skip mobile-qbe-filter (loads unnecessary data)
- Forget to test on low-end mobile devices
- Perform expensive computations in tight loops
- Ignore memory constraints
- Use this approach when simple QBE filtering would work

**Memory Optimization Tips:**
- Use mobile-qbe-filter to pre-filter data before loading all
- Only load fields needed for computation
- Clear intermediate data structures after computation
- Monitor memory usage during development
- Test with maximum expected data volume
- Consider pagination if dataset is very large

## Performance Considerations

**Loading All Records:**
- Each `loadRange` call fetches one page from local database
- Multiple pages = multiple database queries
- Can impact performance with very large datasets
- Always test with realistic data volumes

**Computation Performance:**
- Keep computation logic efficient
- Avoid nested loops where possible
- Use array methods like `filter`, `reduce` efficiently
- Consider caching computed values if recalculated frequently

**Memory Impact:**
- Loading all records increases memory usage
- JSON datasource adds additional memory overhead
- Test on devices with limited memory (older phones)
- Monitor memory in DevTools during development

## Summary

Use this advanced configuration when:
- ✅ QBE filtering cannot express your logic
- ✅ You need complex calculations across all records
- ✅ You need custom aggregations
- ✅ You've tested memory usage on target devices
- ✅ Simple configuration is insufficient

**Key Components:**
1. **allowedAllRecordsLoadDS**: Safety array for datasources that can load all records
2. **maximo-datasource**: Shares data from source app with mobile-qbe-filter
3. **json-datasource**: Holds computed values for tile display
4. **DataController**: Loads all records, computes values, updates JSON datasource

**Remember:** Always prefer the [Simple Configuration](/simple/add-dashboard-tile) when possible. Only use this advanced approach when absolutely necessary, and always test memory usage on actual mobile devices.
